title: Sunday · the cedar mill
logline: Chloe home, in an expensive coat. The walk through the shuttered mill. The travelogue Sunday, with a person in it.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the abandoned cedar mill from the road, August, watercolor: the long shed, the smokestack, blackberry taking the loading dock, a chain across the drive. CHLOE and WOOD ducking the chain. BARNABY under it.

image.prompt: an abandoned cedar mill in August watercolor, a long shed and a smokestack, blackberry overtaking the loading dock, a young woman in an expensive camel coat and a young man in a chore coat ducking under a chain across the drive, a gray-muzzled dog, no words
image.notes: Chloe at 28: the camel coat, short expensive hair. She's drawn better than the mill.

panels.name: The chain

panels.composition: Tier 2: inside the shed. Light through the roof's missing panels in long bars. The saw, rusted. Their two shapes small in the bars of light.

image.prompt: the inside of a vast abandoned mill shed with light falling through missing roof panels in long bars, a rusted saw, two small figures walking through the bars of light, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Bars

panels.composition: Tier 3: the two of them on the loading dock, feet over the blackberry. Talking. The strip gives them one exchange.

balloons.text: I have a firm. Boutique. Strategy. I say 'brand narrative' out loud, Wood. In meetings.
I saw. The Long Way Back. Is it back yet.

image.prompt: a young woman in a camel coat and a young man sitting on an abandoned mill's loading dock with their feet over blackberry brambles, watercolor

panels.name: The dock

panels.composition: Tier 4: from behind, the two of them walking out under the chain, the dog first, the smokestack over them. The strip's Chloe seen from the back — her coat the only warm color.

image.prompt: a young woman in a warm camel coat and a young man seen from behind walking out of an abandoned mill under a chain, a dog ahead of them, the smokestack above, watercolor, no words
image.notes: The camel coat is the only warm color on the page.

panels.name: Out

art.palette: gray-green, rust, blackberry black; one camel coat

notes: The mill, 2008. 'I say brand narrative out loud.' 'It's long.' The mill returns in forty ROFLCOPTER pages.
